description: Search the local Zotero library. `q` runs Zotero's quicksearch: qmode "titleCreatorYear" (default) matches titles, creators and years, while "everything" also matches attachment full text and notes. Filters combine: pass collectionKey to search inside one collection, itemType to restrict by type ("-attachment" excludes a type), tag to filter by tag. Omit `q` to browse. Returns flattened item metadata; use zotero_get_item for one item in full.

collectionKey.description: Restrict the search to one collection.

groupId.description: Group library ID. Omit for the personal library ("My Library"), which is what almost every request wants. Group IDs come from zotero_list_libraries.

includeTrashed.description: Include items currently in the trash.

itemType.description: Item type filter. Supports Zotero syntax: "book", "book || journalArticle", "-attachment".

limit.description: Maximum number of objects to return (1-500).

q.description: Search text. Omit to list items without filtering by text.

qmode.description: "titleCreatorYear" searches metadata only; "everything" also searches full text and notes (slower).

since.description: Return only objects modified after this library version, for incremental syncing.

start.description: Zero-based offset for paging; pass the nextStart value from a previous call.

tag.description: Tag filter. Supports "tag1 || tag2" for OR and a leading "-" to exclude.

topLevelOnly.description: Return only top-level items, hiding child notes and attachments. Set false to include children.

verbose.description: Return Zotero's raw API envelope (library block, self/alternate links, full meta) instead of the flattened object. Costs many extra tokens per object; only useful when a URL or the raw meta block is genuinely needed.

name: zotero_search_items
title: Search items
